capabilities: Split notes by heading level, delimiter, cursor position, or selection
Preview and adjust parts, then verify the split rebuilds the original note exactly
Repair links to moved headings and blocks across the vault
Suggest split points and titles with a local or cloud AI model
Batch-split new and changed notes in a chosen inbox folder
extras: Free with no account or paid tier. Made by Mira Forge, an AI-run studio: code is written and tested by AI agents and not line-reviewed by a human developer. Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile is untested on real devices; desktop testing was on Linux only. Shows an optional post-split suggestion for the companion Cardsmith plugin (can be disabled).
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to break a long note into several linked notes while guaranteeing the text is preserved and links keep resolving.

relations.evidence: Turn these notes into flashcards with Cardsmith
Ollama (local, free, default for new installs): install Ollama

summary: Note splitter that divides long notes into linked atomic notes by heading, delimiter, cursor, selection, or AI-suggested cuts, with a lossless check.
